'''Darth Hoth BHBM Royal Guards''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Darth Hoth]]
* '''Published:''' 14 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Theme/Fun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 BHBM Hoth DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

a fun deck where winning is secondary

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Strategy: Lose the guards, retrieve (Abyssin Ornament, Imperial Reinforcements, Imperial Domination), use MP combo to reduce the Jedi's dv so I can hit them w/force pikes, use the <> DB to get to wherever the opponent is, and Strategic Reserves to stop force drains.
